description: Pixel-art string lights with gently pulsing bulbs in your VS Code title bar.
cfg.aktiv: Set by the commands. After a VS Code update you will be asked to turn the lights on again.
cfg.position.titelleiste: Behind the title bar – menu and title stay readable (recommended).
cfg.position.statusleiste: Behind the status bar at the bottom.
cfg.position.ueberAllem: Floats at the very top, above everything (covers text).
cfg.animation: How the bulbs pulse. When the VS Code window is in the background, the animation pauses automatically (title bar position).
cfg.animation.sparsam: Pulses in fine steps – uses much less CPU (recommended).
cfg.animation.fluessig: Pulses perfectly smoothly – looks best, uses the most CPU.
cfg.animation.aus: Glows steadily without pulsing – uses no CPU.
cfg.groesse: Size of one pixel in screen pixels (2 = default).
cfg.abstandOben: Only for position «ueberAllem»: distance from the top edge in pixels.
